title: hicorius × dunbarii
intro: Hicorius × dunbarii, commonly known as Hicoria, is a species of plant in the family Juglandaceae. This plant is a hybrid of the Hicoria glabra and the Hicoria ovata. The Hicoria plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
